title: Migrate REST endpoint to a versioned API contract
description: An existing unversioned REST endpoint (/users/:id) needs to become /v2/users/:id with a changed response shape (nested profile object instead of flat fields), while the original unversioned endpoint must continue serving the old flat response shape unchanged for existing clients during a transition period.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /v2/users/:id returns the new nested response shape for existing fixture data.
GET /users/:id (unversioned) continues to return the original flat response shape unchanged.
Both endpoints share the same underlying data-fetching logic rather than duplicating the query.
A newly-added field only appears in the v2 response, not the legacy response, unless explicitly required otherwise.
Existing tests for the unversioned endpoint pass unchanged; new tests cover the v2 endpoint's shape.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run existing unversioned-endpoint tests unchanged plus new v2-endpoint tests asserting the nested shape.
groundTruth: A shared internal fetch function returns a canonical user record; two thin response-shaping layers (legacy flat mapper, v2 nested mapper) sit on top of the same fetch, registered on their respective routes.
